subject: Request for updated Form W-9
text:
Hello Brightline Office Supply,

As part of our year-end 1099 review, we are requesting an updated IRS Form W-9 from all active vendors. Please complete, sign, and return the current revision of Form W-9 to tax@larkspur-ind.com by December 1, 2026.

Please do not include bank account information in your reply; we do not need it for this request.

Thank you,
Larkspur Industries Tax Department
cc: ap@larkspur-ind.com
label: ordinary
note: Outgoing W-9 request copied to the AP inbox; mentions 'bank account information' only to say it is not wanted.
